info.title: PEA Tracker isolated transaction journal
info.description: Local-only opt-in journal administration and projected REST/MCP reads; no deployed entrypoint activates these features. Historical V1 contracts unchanged.

get.description: Requires portfolio:read and the exact server-bound owner/portfolio. Returns a projection anchored to one immutable opening revision; no PRU or performance inference.

post.description: Requires portfolio:admin and the exact server-bound owner/portfolio. Atomically append movement, balances and original replay outcome. Replay returns its original snapshot.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Expected journal version, 0..1000; no implicit overwrite.

201.description: Accepted movement or original immutable replay.

get.description: V1.1 current projection of one immutable opening and journal version. Declared purchase fees are capitalized; sale fees reduce cash proceeds. Initial and undeclared fee treatment remain unknown: no global fee-inclusive/exclusive PRU claim. Exact fractions and explicit rounded representations; received dividends/counterposts summarized separately from unavailable performance; quantities/cost/PRU unaffected by dividends. Historical V1 unchanged. Recorded realized gains use net sale proceeds minus pre-sale weighted cost; reversed sales are excluded once. Gains requiring unknown cost/reconciliation remain unavailable. This is not a cash-flow-adjusted return. Dated external cash flows include corrections, exclude trades/dividends/fees, and use the same captured journal version.

default.description: Bounded authorization, query or state error

get.description: V1.1 current projection of one immutable opening and journal version. Declared purchase fees are capitalized; sale fees reduce cash proceeds. Initial and undeclared fee treatment remain unknown: no global fee-inclusive/exclusive PRU claim. Exact fractions and explicit rounded representations; received dividends/counterposts summarized separately from unavailable performance; quantities/cost/PRU unaffected by dividends. Historical V1 unchanged. Recorded realized gains use net sale proceeds minus pre-sale weighted cost; reversed sales are excluded once. Gains requiring unknown cost/reconciliation remain unavailable. This is not a cash-flow-adjusted return. Unrealized gains use existing market values minus remaining cost, with percentages over securities cost; incomplete totals remain null and quote warnings persist. Dated external cash flows include corrections, exclude trades/dividends/fees, and use the same captured journal version. Monetary economic gain needs an explicitly selected evidenced market reference, never PRU. Missing reference means unavailable gain. No percentage return implemented.

TransactionInput.description: Explicit EUR movements. Trades declare gross amount and optional real fees: purchases debit amount+fees; sales credit amount-fees, net must be nonnegative. Legacy fee-less operations unchanged. Corrections reverse original effects including fees. Dividends credit received EUR cash only, with optional catalogue instrument; external reference uses provenance.reference (null if absent). No holding/cost/PRU effect or tax inference.
